four repeated horizontal actions wrap and keep reversible history
800ms turns into corner; 801ms goes to fill
up down ladder uses the existing collapse implementation
minimum width refusal is a no-op
CSS refusal rolls back and retains the previous undo entry
manual movement revokes stale undo without fighting the user
close and reopen in one task revokes history

name: fixed-size windows can roll up but are never stretched
CSS-owned, modal and fullscreen windows refuse geometry writes
aspect-locked canvas remains in its corner with its aspect
Finder fit tokens and ownership survive undo
offscreen recovery moves but never resizes or expands the shade

name: late-created windows get the same delegated menu and geometry
context menu targets the clicked window and stays within the viewport
menu keyboard navigation and Escape restore focus
editable fields, IME and repeats never dispatch window shortcuts
real entry key delivery reaches the unified ladder
cold-load focus race cannot arrange the old or the new active window

steps.evaluate: check(api.dispatch(win,'rightHalf').ok,'first placed'); check(api.dispatch(getWindow('second'),'leftHalf').ok,'second placed'); getWindow('second').style.left='333px'; await tick();

const area=api.areaFor(win); check(Math.abs(rect().left+rect().width-area.left-area.width)<2,'managed window refitted'); check(getWindow('second').style.left==='333px','manual peer untouched'); check(api.dispatch(win,'undo').ok,'undo after refit'); check(rect().width===560,'home size preserved');

name: entering mobile yields without fighting the mobile shell

steps.evaluate: api.dispatch(win,'leftHalf'); window.beforeMobile=win.getAttribute('style');

check(!api.dispatch(win,'fill').ok,'mobile arrangement disabled'); check(win.getAttribute('style')===window.beforeMobile,'adapter did not write mobile geometry'); check(!api.canUndo(win),'desktop history released');

name: a changed size constraint revokes old history

steps.evaluate: api.dispatch(win,'leftHalf'); win.style.maxWidth='500px'; await tick(); check(!api.canUndo(win),'changed constraint revoked undo'); check(!api.dispatch(win,'undo').ok,'no stale restore'); check(win.style.maxWidth==='500px','new constraint retained');

name: SideAsk-owned split is not taken over by window arrangement

steps.evaluate: win.dataset.sideaskRestoreActive='true'; const home=win.getAttribute('style'); check(!api.dispatch(win,'rightHalf').ok,'SideAsk refused'); check(win.getAttribute('style')===home,'SideAsk frame unchanged');

name: existing modal scrim blocks entry without consuming the shortcut

steps.evaluate: modalScrim.classList.remove('is-hidden'); const home=win.getAttribute('style'); const key=new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'ArrowRight',ctrlKey:true,metaKey:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}); document.body.dispatchEvent(key); await tick(); check(!key.defaultPrevented,'modal shortcut not consumed'); check(!api.dispatch(win,'fill').ok,'modal operation refused'); check(win.getAttribute('style')===home,'modal geometry unchanged');

name: each window owns its undo history independently

steps.evaluate: api.dispatch(win,'leftHalf'); const left=rect(); api.dispatch(getWindow('second'),'rightHalf'); check(api.dispatch(getWindow('second'),'undo').ok,'second undo'); check(same(rect(),left),'first retained layout'); check(api.canUndo(win),'first still has undo'); check(api.dispatch(win,'undo').ok,'first undo'); check(rect().width===560,'first home');

name: undo history is bounded to 20 arrangements

steps.evaluate: for(let i=0;i<25;i++) check(api.direction(win,'left',i*1000).ok,'arrange'); for(let i=0;i<20;i++) check(api.dispatch(win,'undo').ok,'bounded undo'); check(!api.canUndo(win),'history bounded');

name: hidden attributes and foreign positioning owners are refused safely

steps.evaluate: win.hidden=true; check(!api.dispatch(win,'shade').ok,'hidden attribute refused'); win.hidden=false; const host=document.createElement('div'); host.style.position='relative'; document.querySelector('.desktop').append(host); host.append(win); check(!api.dispatch(win,'shade').ok,'foreign geometry owner refused');

name: Finder decoration updates neither erase undo nor get rolled back

steps.evaluate: win.style.setProperty('--finder-continuation-top','20px'); api.dispatch(win,'leftHalf'); win.style.setProperty('--finder-continuation-top','30px'); await tick(); check(api.canUndo(win),'decoration does not own geometry'); check(api.dispatch(win,'undo').ok,'undo still works'); check(win.style.getPropertyValue('--finder-continuation-top')==='30px','latest decoration retained');
